title: CPF Module Schema: AI Foundry module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-aifoundry'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_name.description: (optional) Customer managed key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

cognitive_deployments.type: map(object({ deployment_name = string model_format = optional(string, "OpenAI") model_name = string model_version = optional(string) dynamic_throttling_enabled = optional(bool) sku = object({ name = string tier = optional(string) size = optional(string) family = optional(string) capacity = optional(number, 1) }) }))
cognitive_deployments.description: (Optional) cognitive_deployments block supports below values: map(object({ deployment_name = "(Required) The name of the Deployment. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." model_format = "(Optional) The format of the Cognitive Services Account Deployment model. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Possible values can be found by running 'az cognitiveservices account list-models'. Available values may include models from AI21 Labs, Black Forest Labs, Cohere, Core42, DeepSeek, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral AI, OpenAI, and xAI. Defaults to 'OpenAI'." model_name = "(Required) The name of the Deployment model. Example : gpt-35-turbo, gpt-35-turbo-instruct, gpt-4, gpt-4-32k, text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-ada-002, gpt-35-turbo-16k, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." model_version = "(Optional) The version of Deployment model. If version is not specified, the default version of the model at the time will be assigned." dynamic_throttling_enabled = "(Optional) Whether dynamic throttling is enabled." sku = "(Required) SKU block supports below values: object({ name = "(Required) The name of the SKU. Possible values include Standard, DataZoneBatch, DataZoneStandard, DataZoneProvisionedManaged, GlobalBatch, GlobalProvisionedManaged, GlobalStandard, and ProvisionedManaged. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." tier = "(Optional) Possible values are Free, Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise. This property is required only when multiple tiers are available with the SKU name. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." size = "(Optional) The SKU size. When the name field is the combination of tier and some other value, then that can be captured here. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." family = "(Optional) If the service has different generations of hardware, for the same SKU, then that can be captured here. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." capacity = "(Optional) Tokens-per-Minute (TPM). The unit of measure for this field is in the thousands of Tokens-per-Minute. Defaults to 1 which means that the limitation is 1000 tokens per minute. If the resources SKU supports scale in/out then the capacity field should be included in the resources' configuration. If the scale in/out is not supported by the resources SKU then this field can be safely omitted." }) }))

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment_aiconnections.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow proper resource deletion when connections are present.

create_role_assignment_cmk.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

create_role_assignment_spn_owner.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the SPN to allow owner access to the AI Foundry resource.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string key_vault_uri = string expiration_date = string identity_principal_id = string identity_client_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." key_vault_uri = "(Required) The URI of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID (object ID) of the User-Assigned Managed Identity for role assignments." identity_client_id = "(Required) The client ID (application ID) of the User-Assigned Managed Identity for encryption." })

customsubdomainname.description: (Required) The subdomain name used for token-based authentication. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

disable_local_auth.description: (Optional) Specifies whether local authentication is disabled for the Azure AI Foundry resource. Defaults to true as mandated by security control AZU-AIF-IA_010. Setting this to false requires a Cyber exemption.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Required) An identity block supports the following: object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this resource. Possible values are SystemAssigned, UserAssigned, SystemAssigned, UserAssigned." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this resource." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

kind.description: (Required) Kind of the resource. For AI Services Account, only 'AIServices' is valid.

network_injections.description: (Optional) Controls the Network Injections on this resource. The following properties can be specified: object({ subnet_id = (Required) Full resource id of the Subnet resource. scenario = (Required) The scenario for the network injection. Only `agent` is supported. })

principal_ids.description: (Optional) Set of principal IDs (user, group, or service principal) to assign the Azure AI User role.

projectmanagementenabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether this resource support project management as child resources, used as containers for access management, data isolation and cost in AI Foundry.

resource_group_id.description: (Required) The resource ID of the Resource Group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Required) Specifies the SKU Name for this AI Services Account. Possible values are F0, F1, S0, S, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, P0, P1, P2, E0 and DC0.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

version_upgrade_option.description: (Optional) Deployment model version upgrade option. Possible values are OnceNewDefaultVersionAvailable, OnceCurrentVersionExpired, and NoAutoUpgrade. Defaults to OnceNewDefaultVersionAvailable.

client_id.description: The clientId of the user-assigned managed identity for the Azure AI Foundry resource.

id.description: The ID of the created Azure AI Foundry resource.

keys.description: The access keys for the Azure AI Foundry resource.

name.description: The name of the created Azure AI Foundry resource.

principal_id.description: The principalId of the user-assigned managed identity for the Azure AI Foundry resource.

resource.description: The Azure AI Foundry resource object.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Aifoundry' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
